messages.author: 0ee8ae7c0d185529
messages.subject: lavaan version for multilevel SEM
parts:
Hi all, 

I'm using the development version 0.6-1.1186. It seems that the cluster subcommand is "Not used yet".  So, is it the case that I can't run a multilevel SEM in lavaan quite yet, or is there another version I can access?

Thanks in advance,

David

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: lavaan version for multilevel SEM
parts:
On 02/08/2018 09:59 PM, David Kaplan wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> I'm using the development version 0.6-1.1186. It seems that the cluster
> subcommand is "Not used yet".  So, is it the case that I can't run a
> multilevel SEM in lavaan quite yet, or is there another version I can
> access?

This version will do fine. It is just the documentation that is not
updated yet. This version will only do two-level within/between models
(ie random intercepts only). No random slopes, no missing data (yet).
And continuous data only.

To get an idea of the syntax, see the slides below (from pages 62 onwards):

http://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/zurich2017/MULTILEVEL/lavaan_multilevel_zurich2017.pdf

Yves.
